Home / Verified Talent / Competency Passport

The competency passport: a profile with evidence.

A structured record of what a BIM professional has been assessed on, with results and verification dates, shared with clients instead of an unverified CV.

What it contains

One page, all the evidence.

01

Discipline and role

The discipline, seniority and roles the professional is assessed for.

02

Verified experience

Project types and responsibilities checked against references.

03

Software results

Results of the software assessment in each tool tested.

04

Technical interview

The outcome of the discipline interview with an engineer.

05

Practical task

How the practical BIM exercise was completed.

06

Verification dates

When each item was last verified, and current availability.

How clients use it

Decide on evidence.

Clients compare shortlisted profiles on the same structured evidence, decide whom to interview and see any gaps before committing. Personal details are shared only when an interview is arranged.
